title: MDI Weekly Update – Week of Oct 26, 2026
headline: MDI week in review: permit corrections wrapped, industrial shelter engineering approved, new Houston and Pearland work lined up
excerpt: Completed the city plan-review corrections on a commercial renovation permit set. Issued a structural assessment and design proposal for a garage apartment renovation in Houston.

title: MDI Weekly Update – Week of Oct 19, 2026
headline: MDI week in review: barndominium proposal out in Jones Creek, care center as-built delivered in Ozona, new pool and MEP work lined up
excerpt: Issued and revised a structural and foundation proposal for a new barndominium in Jones Creek. Delivered an as-built drawing set for a care center in Ozona.

title: MDI Weekly Update – Week of Oct 12, 2026
headline: MDI week in review: new coastal residence awarded in Palacios, structural plans out for review, care center and residential work moving forward
excerpt: Issued a proposal and scope of work for a new coastal residence in Palacios; the client accepted and the project is queued. Sent structural plans for an elevated coastal residence to the client for review and issued updates addressing builder comments on pilings and stringers.
